feeds.title: Past Lane Travels
feeds.description: Jessica James is an author who loves to share her passion for travel, U.S. History, Lifestyle, and the Military, as well as Animals/Pets, the Outdoors, and the Environment. The ability to discover new places and experience the culture of small towns is what makes road-tripping her preferred method of travel. Past lane travels is a resource for anyone looking for historic places in the US.

feeds.title: Celtic Wanderlust Blog
feeds.description: Celtic Wanderlust is a travel blog where history and wanderlust meet. Hi! my name is Chris and I am a Dublin-based travel blogger with a passion for the history of Celtic nations. I explore the best heritage sites while enjoying the local traditions. I hope to provide travelers with clear, accessible, and interesting heritage sites in the area and local culture through this blog.

feeds.title: At World's Origins
feeds.description: At World's Origins is a travel blog that provides you with an exciting and informative journey through the world's most amazing archaeological and historical places and adventure destinations. Our goal is to inspire travelers to witness and experience the beauty of this world by visiting movie-like locations, exploring ancient ruins, and hiking to popular and hidden gems that few have seen.

feeds.title: Vida Colorado
feeds.description: I'm a husband, dad, and newly minted pilot figuring out expat life with my family in Amsterdam, NL. On any given weekend, you'll find us at the park, wandering a rainy market in search of Dutch cheese and stroopwafels, or waiting at Schiphol for our next adventure. This is our journey of building a new kind of American Dream — one flight, one story, and one rainy day at a time.

feeds.title: Castles and Turrets
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Isobel! I'm a history travel blogger, I detail my visits to castles, historic buildings, and all my adventures! I always try my best to provide you with helpful travel posts, either of places that you need to visit or what you can do to make your travels better! I'm also a huge film and book fan, so I have incorporated that too into this blog.

feeds.title: History Fangirl Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie describes herself as an amateur historian and travel enthusiast, she travels around the world full-time visiting historic sites: hidden chapels, Communist monuments, ancient cities, religious relics, national parks, or any place that is beautiful, interesting, or weird. Her blogs will guide you if you are planning to visit the USA, Europe, & Beyond.

feeds.title: History in High Heels Blog
feeds.description: History in High Heels is the journey of Ashley Buchanan through academia equal parts fashion, travel, and higher education. Everything will be small and bespoke, uniquely crafted by Anna and Ashley to showcase what they love about Tuscany and Rome.

feeds.title: Let's Dive into Japanese History » Travel
feeds.description: My name is Stuart. I blog about my visits to various breweries in Kyushu. I started this page to introduce sake (nihonshu) from Kyushu to everyone around the world. I love Japanese history, so I will give you a rundown of the history of each brewery if I can.

feeds.title: American History Road Trip
feeds.description: Ria and Jim host the American History Road Trip. They want to bring you a little historical background on some fun travel destinations. Ria's love of travel and interest in exploring American history have combined with her passion for teaching and writing and have found expression in this blog. Jim is Ria's partner in her endeavors holding the camera.

feeds.title: Archaeology Travel
feeds.description: Archaeology Travel is an online travel guide for people who enjoy exploring the world's past. The website pays its way to producing accurate, unbiased content that promotes responsible travel and engagement with heritage sites. We also recommend themed activities, visiting archaeological and historical sites and museums, tours, and cruises, again based on our own experiences. We inspire for where to go and what to see.

feeds.title: Destination WWII Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Ashley, a full-time travel writer based in Boston, MA. I've traveled to 30 countries on 4 continents and I formed Destination: WWII with a desire to encourage and help travelers visit WWII sites around the world. On Destination WWII BLOG you'll find all of my posts, arranged in chronological order from newest to oldest. Happy reading! As always, if there is something you'd like to see here, get in touch!

feeds.title: Jaunting Jen
feeds.description: I'm Jen. Teacher, historian, traveler, yogi, bread-maker. Army Veteran with Multiple Sclerosis. This is a place to explore the history, travel, and everything else. History is cool, if you know where to look.

feeds.title: World By Isa
feeds.description: Blog hosted by Isadora, a half Brazilian half Hungarian who loves to travel around and learn about Culture, History & Languages. Aimed at those with a passion for travel, the blog focus on building short-term itineraries, and provides travelers with tips. It also provides insight into cultural & historical aspects as well as comfortable options and solutions to amazing adventures.

feeds.title: The Historian Traveller
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Laura! The historian Traveler journal of culture and history for the lovers of wanderlust. The Historian Traveller aims to raise historical awareness of current tourism. Moreover, it uses passion and knowledge to experience travel and history from a different perspective through photography and social media. The Historian Traveller also promotes nature, architecture, landscape photography, and unique stays.

feeds.title: Travel & History Blog
feeds.description: Frans Betgem is a Dutch national who is passionate about history and traveling. He likes 'Then and Now' pictures. Most of the articles he wrote for this website are about the history of Chiang Mai and less about travel. He owns a tour business that focuses on the history, traditions, and local culture.

feeds.title: TripAnthropologist » History Travel
feeds.description: History travel is a feature of the Trip Anthropologist travel resource site that focuses on the history and culture of some of the world's most iconic destinations spiced up by food and wine. Trip Anthropologist provides information about exciting and historically important places to help you plan your next trip.

feeds.title: Travel n Thrill » History & Culture
feeds.description: Experience the rich Indian culture and heritage with numerous forts and palaces, different religious festivities, and traditions in different Indian states. Travel N Thrill is an Indian travel blog and travelers community. It's a free content-sharing platform for travelers. Explore the best of Indian historical places, temples, spiritual destinations, epic stories, and a lot more about India with Deepak Patel at the best Indian travel blog.

feeds.title: TravelBox » History
feeds.description: Discover the historical places, events, stories, cultural heritage, and more. TravelBox is the place where travelers can get inspired. TravelBox is a collaborative travel blog that allows you to create an online travel journal. The purpose of this website is to put together a list of things travelers can explore, and make you think about what is worth doing.

feeds.title: Turkish Travel Blog » History
feeds.description: The blog covers the history of Turkey, along with cultural and traditional elements. The Turkish Travel Blog aims to inspire people to visit the country of Turkey. We feature a variety of destinations from the east to the west and focus on Turkish food, culture, history, lifestyle, and expat living. Our blog is for all niches of travelers including a budget, luxury, adventure, history lovers, and road trip junkies.

feeds.title: Old World Voyages Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer, the writer, and photographer behind Old World Voyages. I love to travel and I'm passionate about history. As someone who loves history, seeking out interesting historical sites, museums, and educational experiences is always a top priority. I created this blog specifically for history nerds like me.

feeds.title: Historianka » History of Travel
feeds.description: My name is Angela Byrne and I'm a historian of eighteenth and nineteenth-century travel, exploration, and emigration, specializing in the experiences of women and migrants in the past. Under the History of Travel section, Angela covers the history of places she visits or the place that is currently in news.

feeds.title: Megan & Aram » Soviet History & Architecture
feeds.description: Hi! We're Megan & Aram! We are travel bloggers who enjoy writing about the Nordics and the Eastern Block. We covered Soviet History & Architecture, giving tips on how one can visit these architectural marvels during the crisis on our blog.
